scope: Bind cancellation bridge to an already-claimed canonical controller without reclaim or task mutation

residual_risks: Scoped native SQLite primitive only: protected bridge provisioning transport, runtime controller binding, signer/profile authentication, and effect-time coordinator/clock/host verification remain unintegrated obligations before live Telegram cancellation can be enabled.

Unconditional live-lease exclusion (`prior.expires_at_ns > now_ns`) rejects same-owner retries with `bridge_bind_lease_already_live`; runtime callers recovering from ambiguous outcomes must reconcile state via `find_bridge_lease` rather than blind retry.

`transaction store` tracks a flat `store.transaction_active` flag without nested SQLite `SAVEPOINT`s, so invoking `bind_bridge_to_claimed_task` inside an existing outer store transaction will abort the enclosing transaction if the bind returns `Error`.

preserved_failures.cause: Zero-fence raw fixture injection correctly refused by SQLite CHECK
preserved_failures.resolution: Disposable corruption fixture only uses explicit local ignore_check_constraints; production CHECK untouched

next: Protected bridge provisioning transport, actual signer/profile ingress, effect-time coordinator/host/clock fences and live cancellation route with uncertain/absent reconciliation. Remaining commands/MiniApp/media/gateway then browser/live acceptance, independent release/admission/main.
